messages:
Maya: Heads up — OrbitCo is pushing hard for a per-request 99.9% latency SLA for Private deployments. Renewal in 3 weeks, CSM flagged as deal-critical.
Samir: they said they'd churn if we don't commit. Sales request: fast patch or an explicit short-term guarantee. 😬
Anya: FYI OrbitCo spends ~+$1.8M/year. renewal probability drops a lot if we don't give something. We can offer credits but they want contractual SLA.
Liam: 99.9% per-request is effectively a re-architecture: dedicated routing, retry guarantees, more infra headroom. Effort = multi-sprint (infra + runtime + e2e tests).
Oliver: Let's do a quick RICE pass to surface options. Hypothetical:
- Reach: 1 (big logo)
- Impact: 8 (revenue + reference)
- Confidence: 4 (we're unsure on infra cost)
- Effort: 20 (high)
=> RICE ~ (1*8*4)/20 = 1.6
Low score for full SLA epic.
Maya: good call. We need alternatives: 1) short-term 'SLA-lite' limited to control-plane calls (lower cost), 2) dedicated capacity pilot (paid add-on, faster but still months), 3) operational runbook + credits + escalation path.
Liam: Option 1 seems implementable in 2–3 weeks: instrument control-plane latency, guarantees only metadata and deployment APIs, not per-token generation. Less infra changes.
Samir: Sales can pitch SLA-lite + 30% credit if we miss. Could buy us time past renewal.
Anya: Will OrbitCo accept partial SLA? I'll check — but sounding hopeful. If not, we need a formal compensating control + rollback clause.
Oliver: Decision proposal: go with Option 1 (SLA-lite) + RICE-guarded roadmap ticket for full per-request SLA as a Q3 epic. Track adoption + headroom metrics. If Anya confirms acceptance, I'll scope PRD and launch criteria.
Maya: +1. Add success metrics: <1% of requests falling into fallback, 95th token-latency for generation under X ms, and explicit cost delta to customer.
Liam: I'll put a tech spike on infra costs and a prototype for control-plane guarantees. ETA 10 working days.
Anya: I'll update OrbitCo and push back timeline expectations. Ping me if sales needs language for contract.
Samir: Thanks — will draft customer phrasing. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: deploy-check — reminder: no prod changes until canary + runbook approved.
Maya: Cool. We'll reconvene next Tue after spike results. Thanks all.
